newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares to maintain steady tone.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares to maintain steady tone.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to open steady Monday after a strong close on Friday.
Dealers said sentiment is cautiously upbeat ahead of the budget this Friday.
"Most people are expecting a few goodies, like corporate tax cuts," said one dealer.
Focus on smaller issues will also continue, she said.
The Straits Times Industrial Index ended at 1,985.94 on Friday.
